project.purpose: Turn admitted operations into durable Workspace/Job/Attempt-controlled physical execution with bounded evidence, cancellation, reconciliation, and recovery while leaving Task meaning and semantic completion to callers.

nodes.label: Workspace
nodes.responsibility: Bind physical work to an isolated Git workspace and exact observed source state.
acceptance: Workspace identity/current source state can be re-read exactly.

nodes.label: JobAttempt
nodes.responsibility: Persist idempotent Job identity and physical Attempt lifecycle separately from caller Task semantics.
acceptance: Retry/Attempt does not fabricate a new semantic Task.

nodes.label: ExecutionOwnership
nodes.responsibility: Own process tree, resource limits, cancellation, and target-specific execution supervision.

nodes.label: ResultArtifact
nodes.responsibility: Retain bounded stdout/stderr/results/artifacts/terminal evidence with exact digests.
acceptance: Result evidence remains available after process exit.

nodes.label: EffectKernel
nodes.responsibility: Preserve ambiguous/lost/orphaned effects and reconcile rather than guessing success or redispatching opaque work.

nodes.label: ExactLeaseGeneration
nodes.responsibility: Bind destructive lifecycle mutation to the exact current execution/generation when multiple lifecycle actors can race.
acceptance: A stale watchdog/canceller cannot affect a replacement execution generation.

slices.objective: Demonstrate or falsify a stale-owner/ABA lifecycle race; introduce explicit Lease/Generation only if the current contracts cannot prevent it.
acceptance: A deterministic concurrency test either proves current identity fencing sufficient or fails and justifies exact Lease/Generation semantics.
slices.nextAction: Write the failing race test before adding lifecycle identity objects.

gaps: Exact Lease/RuntimeGeneration are comparison coordinates, not yet claimed as implemented Runtime primitives by this plan.

review.notes: Initial project-native LEGO planning projection. It does not replace owner-native architecture or evidence.

sharedCatalog.note: Optional shared coordinates only; project-native semantics remain authoritative.
